label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To whoever's been putting their rubbish in my bin,

I live at No. 14. It's the grey bin with the big white 14 painted on the lid, so there's no mistaking whose it is.

For about the last month someone has been filling it with their own rubbish. Not the odd bit, full black bags, every week. Last Tuesday I got home from work at 3am and the lid wouldn't even close. There were three bags in it that weren't mine, one of them full of nappies. Lovely.

I'm with Greenmount and they charge by weight, 41 cent a kilo. My bill is usually around €25 for two months. The last one was €63.20. That's nearly 100 kilos of someone else's rubbish I've paid for. I'm renting and I'm not made of money, so that's coming to an end.

I know it's someone on this terrace. There was a gas bill envelope in one of the bags with the name torn off but Aughrim Terrace still on it. Whoever tore the name off, fair play for thinking of it, but you didn't think hard enough. A car was also seen pulling up on Tuesday evening, so people are noticing.

I work nights, so I'm out when the bins go out, which I'm guessing someone has copped. That doesn't mean I'm a pushover or that I won't notice. I've noticed.

If you're stuck and don't know how to sort out your own bin, just knock on my door and ask. I'll happily tell you who to ring. It's not hard, it's one phone call.

All I want is for it to stop. That's it. No drama, no fuss, it just stops and we all get on with things.

If it keeps happening, the bin's getting a padlock, and whoever it is can find somewhere else to put their nappies.

Thanks,
No. 14
